# GGIT — GiGi, the 24/7 AI Voice Receptionist for Dental Clinics

> GGIT (Global Group Intelligence Technologies Ltd) builds GiGi, an AI voice receptionist for dental clinics in the United States, United Kingdom and Switzerland. GiGi answers every patient call 24/7, books appointments directly into dental practice management software (e.g. Dentrix, Open Dental), answers clinic FAQs and runs patient recall campaigns.

## Product: GiGi AI Voice Receptionist

- 24/7/365 AI call answering on the first ring, with unlimited simultaneous calls (no busy signals or voicemail)
- Books appointments during the call by checking live slots in the clinic's practice management software (PMS), then sends an SMS confirmation
- Answers clinic FAQs: accepted insurance, pricing, parking, pre- and post-operative care
- Outbound recall campaigns to reactivate past patients and fill last-minute cancellations
- Full call transcripts and summaries
- Identifies itself as an AI at the start of every call
- Done-for-you setup in under 7 days: the clinic forwards calls from its existing phone line; no hardware or staff training needed
- Built for US HIPAA, UK GDPR and Swiss FADP requirements; GGIT signs a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with HIPAA-covered practices before activation
- Data retention: voice recordings 30 days, transcripts and summaries 90 days

## Pricing

- United States: $250 per month
- United Kingdom: £249 per month
- Switzerland: CHF 279 per month
